Dayananda Sagar University vs Garden City University is an undergraduate journalism comparison on our records, not a postgraduate media ranking. Fees are missing for Garden City University, and placements are missing on both sides.

sections.heading: Dayananda Sagar University vs Garden City University for Mass Communication: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Dayananda Sagar University if you want the listed BA in Journalism at the recorded year total of ₹1.10 lakh, after you confirm the official notice.
Choose Garden City University if you want the listed BA Journalism (Honours), Psychology and English programme, after you get the official fee, which is missing from our table.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what is missing
paragraphs: For Dayananda Sagar University we hold ₹1.10 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for BA in Journalism. That is a year amount, not a confirmed three-year official total.
Garden City University has no fee row on this page. A blank cell is not a free degree. Use the official notice on the Garden City University site.
Both listed programmes are undergraduate journalism or combined arts programmes. Do not treat them as postgraduate mass-communication degrees unless the official prospectus says so.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We have no mass-communication placement row for either university, so this page cannot quote an average or highest package.
Ask both career offices for a recent journalism or media outcomes note. An empty package cell is not a reason to invent a figure.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each university's official undergraduate admissions process.
Garden City University has an India Today rank of 36 from 2021 on our records. That year is old, and it is not a NIRF rank. Dayananda Sagar University has no rank row here.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are private universities in Bangalore, so a local student can visit the media labs on the same trip.
The listed Garden City programme also names psychology and English, so the classroom mix may differ from a standalone journalism BA. Confirm the exact award title.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Dayananda Sagar University if the recorded ₹1.10 lakh year total for BA in Journalism is clear, after official confirmation.
Pick Garden City University if the listed honours journalism programme fits you, and you have the official fee in hand.
Because placements are missing, let the exact degree title, campus visit and official fee decide this comparison.
